cases.name: Milana Li
cases.about: She was in 6th grade. Friends and family described her as a doting older sister, budding guitarist and aspiring preschool teacher. "She was a really nice and funny person," Milana's classmate Yara Aqooly told KPTY-TV. "If she was inside a room, she would just brighten up the whole room."
cases.narrative: On 5/10/2023, her body was found submerged underwater in a shallow creek approximately a mile from her apartment and school located off the Westside Regional Trail, near the intersection of Southwest Barrows Road and Horizon Boulevard in Beaverton, OR. Police classified her death as a homicide.

cases.name: Oulaykham Mona Chopheng
cases.about: Her Facebook profile said she was from Vientiane, Laos.
cases.narrative: On 2/23/2023, police found her body on a couch during a welfare check. She had been shot in the head.
